entities.summary: Christopher Jan Niedenthal is a British-Polish photographer and photojournalist. He is a member of the Association of Polish Art Photographers and his work has been published in Newsweek, Time, Der Spiegel and Forbes. In 1986 he received a World Press Photo prize for a portrait of János Kádár.
